name: idle-handoff
description: Warns when the session sits idle before the prompt cache expires, saves a handoff summary (on idle, /exit or /clear), and offers it to the next session in the same project

idleWarnMinutes.title: Warn after idle (minutes)
idleWarnMinutes.description: How long the session sits idle after Claude's last reply before you're warned that the prompt cache is about to expire.

graceMinutes.title: Grace period (minutes)
graceMinutes.description: How long after the warning to wait for a reply before the handoff summary is written. Keep warn + grace under 60 so the summary is still served from the prompt cache.

onIdle.title: When the grace period ends
onIdle.description: summarize: write the handoff summary. warn-only: only warn, never write one.

onExit.title: On /exit and /clear
onExit.description: ask: offer to save a summary first (only when there's unsaved work). always: save one without asking. never: do nothing.

onStart.title: When a saved summary exists at start
onStart.description: ask: show a band to load or discard it. load: load it into context automatically. off: say nothing (/handoff still loads it).

summaryWords.title: Summary length (words)
summaryWords.description: Upper bound on the handoff summary's length.

desktopNotify.title: Desktop notification
desktopNotify.description: Also send the idle warning as a desktop notification (notify-send on Linux).
